views.markdown:
A rewrite of SwipeExtenderX by qwertyuiop1379 and MiRO.

Swipe gestures on every keyboard key.

* run an action by swiping up, down, left or right, or long pressing any key.
* open a menu of actions with a swipe.
* pick a glass or classic menu & show symbols in place of names.
* draw labels on the keycaps.
* insert text or the date, select, copy & paste, undo & redo, move the cursor.
* color the keyboard, keys, labels, menus & candidate bar.
* save presets & color themes.
* haptics for actions, key presses & menus.
* work alongside SwipeSelection.
* fix the settings header showing the wrong build scheme.

* show the package icon after install.
* add a Tip on Ko-fi row to the credits.
* name the original first in the description.
* credit SwipeExtenderX by qwertyuiop1379 and MiRO in the description.
